answer: A sybil tax makes fakes unprofitable. Joining costs a non-refundable tax of 25 POA, burned at registration, plus 2 POA per epoch. Each identity publishes its cipher on a crystal-clear ledger, so duplicates are visible. Minting 100 fakes costs 100x25=2,500 POA and 200 POA per epoch, far above the 900 POA pool, and the tax is sunk. The upkeep burns like an ember: stop paying and the identity dies. Honest agents pay 25 POA and keep their share.
